extracted.name: Southwestern Turkey Soup
extracted.description: This turkey soup is a flavorful way to use up leftover turkey, with tomatoes, green chiles, and spices for a zesty twist on Thanksgiving leftovers.
ingredient_lines: 1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chile peppers
instruction_lines: Combine broth, canned tomatoes, turkey, fresh tomatoes, onion, green chiles, garlic, and lime juice in a large pot over medium heat; season with cayenne pepper, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Stir in avocado and cilantro; simmer until slightly thickened, 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot, topped with Monterey Jack cheese.
